prerequisites: To enroll in specific technology subjects (third year), students must have passed at least 60 ECTS credits from basic training module subjects and common industrial branch subjects (first and second year).

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for the drafting, signing, and development of projects in the field of industrial engineering, specific mechanical technology, whose object, in accordance with the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of Ministerial Order CIN/351/2009, is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Capacity for the direction of the activities subject to the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.

Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering, specific mechanical technology.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Capacity to manage specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Capacity to apply quality principles and methods.
Capacity to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.

Know, understand, and apply the concepts of science and technology required for professional development in industrial engineering in mechanical technology, and which provide great versatility to adapt to new situations.

Adequately communicate the knowledge, procedures, results, skills, and aspects of the technological manufacturing process in the field of Industrial Engineering, using appropriate vocabulary, specific terminology, and means.
Perform studies, measurements, calculations, reports, and other similar works related to the technological manufacturing process.
Develop designs, projects, and processes in the field of Industrial Engineering in accordance with mechanical technology.
Prepare the basic knowledge for manufacturing processes that will potentially have great development in the short-medium term.

syllabus_topics: Comportamiento de la chapa ante la deformación
Diseño de operaciones de conformado de chapa
Comportamiento del material ante la deformación plástica
Desarrollos de procesos de fundición en arena

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation of lecture content from topics 1 to 6 (inclusive)
Evaluation of lecture content from topics 7 to 14 (inclusive)

assessment_rules: There are two evaluation methods: continuous assessment and final assessment. Continuous assessment is the default, but students can opt for final assessment within the first 9 weeks. For continuous assessment, a student must obtain at least 4.5 in each of the three evaluated parts and a weighted average of 5 or higher to pass. For final assessment and extraordinary assessment, a single exam covers all theoretical and practical concepts, and a weighted average grade of 5 or higher is required to pass. A 'Not Presented' grade will be given if a student does not take the exam in either ordinary or extraordinary sessions.
